%% Regex Torture Test
%% Each entry below is a minimal, non-failing LaTeX snippet that exercises
%% an edge case previously caught by a bug report.  The test suite compiles

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}

%% From BUG-23: \newtheorem print-name with nested braces (\ref{...})
\newtheorem*{def31}{Definition \ref{def:afb}}

\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}

\begin{document}

\begin{theorem}
Hello.
\end{theorem}

\end{document}
